data.title: 入巢莳菜 · 露天温泉微雾岩石畔的娇羞依偎
data.description: 美浜合宿山间的露天温泉中，水汽袅袅升腾。莳菜不着一物浸在温热的泉水边，双臂抱胸靠在光滑的暖石旁。如瀑的金色超长双马尾浮在水面，蒸腾热气将她整个人蒸得粉嫩通红，睫毛挂着晶莹水汽，羞怯而依赖地侧目凝视。
data.location: 山间旅馆私人露天温泉池畔
data.action: 半浸温泉靠在岩石旁，手臂遮胸，羞怯侧眸凝望
data.lighting: 温泉水面波光与竹林幽静月色
promptTokens: very long twintails floating on water
data.promptProse: Submerged to her chest in the steamy outdoor hot spring, her endless candy-pink twintails spread across the water's surface. Lantern light filters through the bamboo grove onto her flushed porcelain skin as she looks over her shoulder with soft timidity.
data.animaCaption: She rests against the hot spring rocks in the rising steam, blushing shyly.
